name: @shellicar/mcp-history

tools.name: SearchHistory
tools.description: Search your past conversations by relevance and get back ranked, cited snippets. A citation is a session id plus a turn id; pass one (or several) to ReadHistory to open the full exchange around it. Thinking is indexed and ranks on par with prose — the reasoning in a thinking block is often the most descriptive account of what a piece of work was.

query.description: Terms to search across your past conversations.

role.description: Narrow to one side: your messages or the assistant's.

type.description: Narrow to one kind of event.

since.description: Lower bound, inclusive. An absolute value snaps to the start of its period (2026-06 → 1 June).

until.description: Upper bound, inclusive. An absolute value snaps to the end of its period (2026-06 → 30 June).

includeCurrentSession.description: The live session is excluded as noise by default; set true to include it.

tools.name: ReadHistory
tools.description: Open the full exchange around one or more search citations. Each citation is a { session, turnId } from a SearchHistory hit; the shared `window` sets how many turns either side of each centre to include. Each event text is capped so one giant tool_result cannot flood context.

session.description: Session id from a search hit.

turnId.description: Turn id from a search hit; the centre of the window.

citations.description: One or more moments to open.

window.description: Turns to include either side of each centre.
